entities.summary:
The Province of German Bohemia was an unrecognised province in Bohemia, self-proclaimed by a group of German-speaking deputies of the 
Imperial Council of Austria on 29 October 1918 at the end of the First World War. With the proclamation, the German-speaking deputies from northern and western parts of Bohemia attempted to secede from the First Czechoslovak Republic, and sought to attach themselves to the unrecognised Republic of German-Austria.
